title: Claim Documentation Sample Sets on Mold Remediation Asbestos Sampling
content:
Claims coordination bulletin for Mold Remediation jobs linked to an Insurance Claim Services claim file: documentation drawn with the pre-removal asbestos samples.

When the claim file linked to the mold job names a public adjuster, a split sample set is drawn for the adjuster and the adjuster split set fee of 110.00 is added to the sampling line. When the linked claim file names no public adjuster and its billing arrangement requires a carrier program referral number, the program chain-of-custody fee of 65.00 is added. Every other job adds no documentation charge.

| Public adjuster named on the linked claim file | Arrangement requires a carrier program referral number | Documentation charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 110.00 split set |
| Yes | No | 110.00 split set |
| No | Yes | 65.00 chain-of-custody |
| No | No | None |
| No linked claim file | — | None |

**Records read.** The public adjuster named on the Insurance Claim Services claim file the mold job is linked to, and whether that file's billing arrangement requires a carrier program referral number.

**Note.** A file naming a public adjuster takes the split set charge only; the chain-of-custody fee is reserved for files that name no public adjuster.
